source: npm run validate:dictation -- --capture --delay=300, against the live Pravah service
note: The achieved result, and the regression floor. test-dictation-pipeline.mjs compares RATES against this, not counts, because a transient upstream failure legitimately changes the denominator — this capture lost 5 Urdu rows to Pravah 422s, which is why graded is 255 and not 260. `clean` is a translation with zero graded failures; `fileable` is one whose completeness check passes, so a doctor could file it (used for reporting only, no assertion depends on it). Re-record deliberately when the numbers improve — never to make a failing run pass. The frozen 0/246 starting point is in dictation-baseline.json and is not edited.
